notes:
This set provides supplementary data for the following paper:
Barienti, K.; Werwein, S.; Herbst, S.; Maier, H.J.; Nürnberger, F. A Novel Way to Reduce the Critical Deformation for Cold Roll Bonding. _Manufacturing Letters_ **2023**, _36_, 9–12, doi:[10.1016/j.mfglet.2022.12.006](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mfglet.2022.12.006).

The dataset includes:
- the raw data for the $$O_2$$ concentration while filling the glovebox (./O2_glovebox)
- .csv files of the image correlation for particle size measurements (./particle_size)
- the qualitative bonding information used for sigmoid fitting (./recuction_bonded)
